LanguageData.RimToll.LetterText: A group from {0} has stopped at your toll post.\n\n{1}
LanguageData.RimToll.StrengthWeak: Few of them, poorly equipped. They are in no position to argue.
LanguageData.RimToll.StrengthEven: They are armed and can hold their own. Nothing you cannot handle, nothing reassuring either.
LanguageData.RimToll.StrengthStrong: The column is heavily armed. Against them, your colony does not count for much.
LanguageData.RimToll.ArmyLetterText:
The army of {0} is marching on {1}. Their road runs through your land.

General {2} has broken off from the column and waits at your post. Behind them, {3} soldiers stand under arms.

They ask for passage. You can sell it, grant it, or close the road. Be aware that {1} will hear about whatever you decide.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageArmyCrossed: {0} has learned that the army of {1} crossed your land.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageArmyStopped: {0} has learned that you barred the road to the army of {1}.
LanguageData.RimToll.BeggarLetterText: A group of beggars from {0} is crossing your land. They have nothing to pay with, and they know it.\n\nOne of them, {1}, offers to stay and work for you for {2} days, in exchange for safe passage and something to eat.
LanguageData.RimToll.MemoryPaidBefore: They have paid at this post before. They remember.
LanguageData.RimToll.MemoryBitter: Your post has a reputation with them, and not a good one. They expect the worst.
LanguageData.RimToll.RecruitOffer: One of them, {0}, has nothing to give. Rather than pay, they offer their hands: they would stay and work for you for {1} days, then be on their way.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageRecruited: {0} leaves the group and will work for you for {1} days.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageContractOver: {0} has served their time and takes to the road again.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageContractStays: {0} has served their time, but their own people have turned hostile to you. With nowhere left to go, they stay.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageOfficerSent: {0} is heading for the toll post.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageNoOfficer: Nobody can reach the toll post.
LanguageData.RimToll.WindowPayInKind: Purse empty: they will pay in goods.
LanguageData.RimToll.WindowRecruit: {0} offers {1} days of work instead of paying.
LanguageData.RimToll.PassShownShort: They present a travel pass in the name of {0}.
LanguageData.RimToll.PassFooter: Issued {0}\nby the hand of the chancellor
LanguageData.RimToll.Reveal1: No one in that group answers to the name on the paper.
LanguageData.RimToll.Reveal2: Count them yourself: the declared party never matched.
LanguageData.RimToll.Reveal3: The likeness belongs to someone else entirely.
LanguageData.RimToll.Reveal4: There is no such month on any calendar.
LanguageData.RimToll.Reveal5: Civilians do not march to war.
LanguageData.RimToll.Reveal6: The chancellor seals in red. Always has.
LanguageData.RimToll.StampApproveTip: Pick up the approval stamp. Then click anywhere on the document to press it down. Right click to put it back.
LanguageData.RimToll.StampDenyTip: Pick up the denial stamp. Then click anywhere on the document to press it down. Right click to put it back.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageUnmasked: The papers do not hold up. Unmasked, they drop their packs and bolt. Among the things they left behind ({0} silver worth of goods): sketches of your colony and a tally of your defences. They came to scout the place for someone else. That someone is not coming.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageUnmaskedEmpty: The papers do not hold up. Unmasked, they bolt without waiting to argue. They carried nothing worth taking: they came to count your defences for someone else. That someone is not coming.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageWronglyAccused: The papers of the {0} group were perfectly in order. Called forgers to their faces, they leave furious.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageBetrayed: The people you waved through under the colours of {0} knew your colony well. Well enough to sell it.
LanguageData.RimToll.PayInKind: Their purse is empty. Whatever they owe, they will pay out of what they are carrying.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageApproaching: A group from {0} is heading for your toll post.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageArmyApproaching: The army of {0} has entered your land and is marching on your post.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessagePaid: The group from {0} dropped {1} silver at the toll post.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessagePaidInKind: The group from {0} left goods worth {1} silver at the toll post.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageAborted: The group from {0} is leaving without paying the toll.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageRefusedPrice: The group from {0} calls your toll robbery. They turn around and leave your territory.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageForcedPrice: The group from {0} ignores your toll and carries on. You are in no position to stop them.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageTurnedAway: The group from {0} turns around. The road is closed to them.
LanguageData.RimToll.MessageForcedBarrier: The group from {0} forces its way through. The road belongs to everyone, apparently.
LanguageData.RimToll.PunitiveText:
{0} has had enough of your toll.

Rather than pay you again, they have handed a purse to men of {1} to come and take back what you extorted. These ones are not here to fight: they are here to help themselves, and will leave as soon as their arms are full.

Your valuables are within their reach.
LanguageData.RimToll.GizmoToggleDesc: While the toll is suspended, passing groups are no longer stopped at this post.
LanguageData.RimToll.GizmoShowMarkerDesc: Show or hide the marker. The toll keeps working either way.
LanguageData.RimToll.Settings.RequireOfficer: Require a colonist at the window
LanguageData.RimToll.Settings.RequireOfficerTip: The papers no longer open straight from the letter. You pick who to send, they walk to the post, and the window only opens once they get there.
